grape_black_rot.name: Grape black rot
grape_black_rot.firstAction: Pick off infected leaves and berries and take them away from the vines.
grape_black_rot.marathi: संक्रमित पाने व मण्यांची तोडणी करून बागेबाहेर न्या.

cards.title: Sanitation
cards.text: Remove mummified berries, spotted leaves, and fallen fruit. Do not compost them near the vineyard.

cards.title: Canopy
cards.text: Thin crowded shoots so leaves dry faster after dew or rain. Black rot spreads on wet foliage.

cards.title: Wait window
cards.text: Scout again after 7 days before any further spray. Repeat removal if new spots appear.

tomato_early_blight.name: Tomato early blight
tomato_early_blight.firstAction: Remove lower spotted leaves and water the soil, not the leaves.
tomato_early_blight.marathi: खालची ठिपके असलेली पाने काढा. मुळाशी पाणी द्या, पानांवर नाही.

cards.title: Leaf removal
cards.text: Pinch off lower leaves that touch soil or show target-spot rings. Bag them away from the plot.

cards.title: Watering
cards.text: Water at the base in the morning. Wet leaves overnight let early blight spread.

cards.title: Wait window
cards.text: Check new growth after 7 days. Keep mulch under plants to stop soil splash.

Potato___Early_blight.name: Potato early blight
Potato___Early_blight.firstAction: Remove blighted leaflets and keep irrigation off the foliage.
Potato___Early_blight.marathi: डाग असलेली पाने काढा. पानांवर पाणी टाकू नका.

cards.title: Sanitation
cards.text: Pull yellow leaves with dark concentric spots. Keep them out of the potato rows.

cards.title: Irrigation
cards.text: Use furrow or drip water. Avoid overhead sprays in the evening.

cards.title: Wait window
cards.text: Walk the field again after 7 days and remove any new lesions before they reach stems.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.name: Maize common rust
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.firstAction: Remove the most rusted leaves and avoid walking the crop while it is wet.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.marathi: तांबेरा असलेली पाने काढा. ओल्या पिकात फिरू नका.

cards.title: Scout
cards.text: Look for cinnamon pustules on both sides of the leaf. Start with the most affected plants.

cards.title: Airflow
cards.text: Do not add plants into already dense stands. Rust needs long leaf wetness.

cards.title: Wait window
cards.text: Recheck after 7 days. If pustules are still spreading up the plant, ask the officer for a spray plan.

grape_healthy.name: Grape — no disease found
grape_healthy.firstAction: Keep routine scouting. No spray is needed from this photo.
grape_healthy.marathi: पीक निरोगी दिसते. नियमित तपासणी सुरू ठेवा. फवारणीची गरज नाही.

cards.title: Keep watch
cards.text: Walk the vines once a week, especially after rain or long dew.

cards.title: Hygiene
cards.text: Clear old bunches and leaves from the trellis so infection has nowhere to sit.
